t: The LAP Fulgora tilt downlight is an indoor lighting solution featuring a white bezel and requiring 1 x GU10 light bulb for versatile illumination. This mains-powered downlight is suitable for domestic use in areas like living rooms and hallways. Its adjustable tilt function allows for precise light direction, perfect for highlighting features or creating ambient zones. Installation is simplified with easy wire connections and a loop in, loop out terminal, streamlining wiring for multiple units. The robust metal body ensures durability, fitting neatly into ceilings with a 72-74mm cut-out.
b: Loop In & Loop Out Terminals Simplify Wiring
Easy Wire Connection for Quick Install
Round Shape & Sleek Design Enhances Interiors
